Dated : 12th June 2024 P.C. :-
1.

This Application is filed seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with C. R. No. 169 of
2023 dated 30 th March 2023, registered with Satana Police Station, District
Nashik(Rural) for alleged offences punishable under Sections 34 and 420 of the
Indian Penal Code.

Anticipatory Bail Application filed by the Applicants before the Additional Sessions Judge,
Malegaon, Nashik is rejected on 12th May 2023.
Hence, this application was filed.
2. By order dated 19th May 2023, ad-interim protection was granted to the applicants on the conditions as recorded in the said order.

3. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the investigation is complete and hence,
ad-interim protection granted by this Court be confirmed.

Learned APP on instructions submits Page no. 2 of 4 13-aba-1479-2023-ia-2599-2023.doc that the investigation is completed and the Prashant Vyankatrao Hiray And Ors vs State Of Maharashtra on 12 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/87410500/
2 charge-sheet is ready and will be filed shortly.

sentences.text: Learned APP further submits that though the investigation is complete and a charge-sheet will be shortly filed the apprehension is that the applicants being influential persons may make an attempt to influence the witnesses.

She therefore submits that an ad-interim protection granted by this court may be confirmed subject to conditions that the applicant shall attend the concerned police station as and when called for and will not influence any of the prosecution witnesses.
She therefore submits that by imposing terms and conditions to that effect ad-interim protection granted by this Court be confirmed.

4. Learned counsel appearing for the intervenor who is the first informant also submits that the conditions may be imposed on the applicants as they being influential persons are likely to influence the witnesses.
5. I have perused the papers.
Perusal of the complaint indicates that the allegations are regarding payment of certain amount for securing employment.
Since the investigation is complete and the charge-sheet is likely to be filed shortly, I do not see any reason that the custody of the applicants would be required.

6. Hence, ad-interim protection granted by order dated 19 th May Page no. 3 of 4 13-aba-1479-2023-ia-2599-2023.doc 2023, is made absolute by passing following order:
I.
II. Applicants shall attend the concerned police station as and when called for by the Investigating Officer.

III. Applicants shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or any promise to any person acquainted with the facts of this case so as to dissuade him/her from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer.
IV. The Applicants shall keep the Investigating Officer informed of their address, e-mail id and mobile phone number and/or any change thereof if any, from time to time.
9. Anticipatory Bail Application is allowed in the above terms.
10. In view of the aforesaid order, the Intervention Application stands disposed of.
